corpus-agent.snippet: (c) The Director shall evaluate the statement and supporting documents, and determine whether the original offset or repayment schedule imposes an extreme financial hardship on the employee.

corpus-agent.title: What special review is available when the Commission is the creditor agency?
corpus-agent.snippet: (2) The request for special review must include an alternative proposed offset or payment schedule and a detailed statement, with supporting documents, that shows why the current salary offset or payment results in extreme financial hardship to the employee, spouse, or dependents.

meta.title: What special review is available when the Commission is the creditor agency?

corpus-agent.title: Special review where FHFA is the creditor agency.
corpus-agent.snippet: (2) The request for special review must include an alternative proposed offset or payment schedule and a detailed statement, with supporting documents, that shows why the current salary offset or payments result in extreme financial hardship to the employee and his or her spouse and dependents.
